messages:
jules: noticed a tiny but consistent UI glitch: when rapidly switching workspaces the Insights card flashes previous workspace rows for ~2s. Seen on canary and one prod report. :frowning:

nina: steps to repro? I can try on canary.

jules: 1) open workspace X, 2) quick-switch to Y (keyboard), 3) immediately open Insights. Sometimes payload returns rows with owner_id from X but header shows Y.

omar: that sounds like connector pool reusing a channel with sticky affinity. We kept gRPC channels warm across tenants to avoid reconnects.

nina: we rolled that pool change last week for fast-prefetch route.

jules: pasted edge log snippet (sanitized):
```
INFO router req=tx42 path=/api/insights headers={"X-Org-ID":"Y"} backend=insights-connector conn_affinity=X
INFO connector fetch returned_rows=4 src_org=X
```

omar: exact problem. conn_affinity is stale on the connection. Quick mitigation: on checkout, assert conn.affinity == req.header_org and if mismatch close+retry. Will add metric `connector.affinity_mismatch`.

nina: also add a subtle UI placeholder: "Validating workspace..." while we revalidate attribution. Flag behind `ui.affinity_revalidate`.

infra-bot: deploy started: router/connector-pool v2.15 -> canary (7%) by omar at 2025-04-10T12:00:00Z

omar: plan: (1) add strict-check config default=false, (2) increment metric + trace annotation on mismatch, (3) failfast retry once, (4) audit other long-lived channels (search, reports).

support: pinging support to expect possible ticket noise during canary.

nina: I'll open a PR for the router change and the dashboard tile for `connector.affinity_mismatch` per-org.

jules: thanks — repro script for QA attached in ticket. small UX copy tweak: "Content paused 14 validating workspace" might read better.

infra-bot: deploy complete: router/connector-pool v2.15 -> canary (7%) by omar at 2025-04-10T12:07:20Z

nina: monitoring shows a few mismatches on canary nodes. low volume so far. will follow up if it spikes. :thumbsup:
